items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Did you ever play with Manuel Perez? No, I never worked with him any, no. ... I knew the family well.

ctx.x: The Eureka band. Yeah. Still up yet. I mean, some of the members yet. The old tuxedas. All of them I put in, knew the men, you know.
Do you remember Manuel Perez? Oh yeah.
In fact, I lived at home often with his sons, you know.
